storage: Airtight jar at room temperature, away from heat, steam and light. Keeps 6–12 months; the oils fade with time, so buy small packs. Can be refrigerated in humid weather to slow staling, but bring to room temperature before opening to avoid condensation.
substitutes: Fennel powder, about half the weight

usedIn.raw: 1 g (½ tsp) dry-roasted and ground into the Chettinad masala, plus 0.5 g (¼ tsp) in the tempering; 1.5 g in total per serving.

mergeNotes: Range 350.0–700.0 was wider than 30% of avg 555.0; narrowed to ±15%.
